attributes.title: Level 1

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using tilemaps in your projects to create customized worlds for sprites to explore!

questions.hint: What uses rows and columns of tiles to make a background in MakeCode?
questions.title: [Select one]  A ____________ is a background with rows and columns of tiles, or re-usable square images.
questions.correctResponse: Using this block, a project’s background is now a map of tiles.

questions.hint: What else can you use a tilemap for in MakeCode?
questions.title: [Select one] Using a tilemap in your project allows you to do which of the following?

answers.text: Set the camera to follow a sprite beyond the screen's starting view
Place sprites on specific coordinates or random tiles of the tilemap
Create walls that block sprite movement in certain areas

questions.correctResponse: Tilemaps allow code to do a lot of new things and more easily control how sprites interact with the background.

questions.hint: What might happen if you set a background image after setting a tilemap?
questions.title: [Select one] The sequence of code blocks does not matter when using a tilemap in your project.
questions.correctResponse: The specific order of code, or sequence, is important throughout the whole program.

questions.hint: Does learning new concepts allow you to create more exciting projects?
questions.title: [Select one] When learning a new coding concept, your understanding of it will continue to grow as you apply it to new and more complex projects.
questions.correctResponse: New concepts allow us to build, explore, and solve with our previous knowledge in new and exciting ways!

subgroups.title: Tilemaps!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using tilemaps in your projects to create customized worlds for sprites to explore!

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of Orange Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about using tilemaps in your projects. You’ll also review sequence, which is the specific order of steps in code.

badges.title: Car-tile-ographer
badges.description: Use the tilemap editor tools in the MakeCode Arcade platform.

badges.title: Charting a Course
badges.description: Create a tilemap and add it to a project.

badges.title: X Marks the Spot
badges.description: Place a sprite on a specific tilemap location.

badges.title: Paparazzi
badges.description: Code the camera to follow a sprite as it moves across a tilemap.

badges.title: Shake it Like a Polaroid Picture
badges.description: Add the camera shake effect to a project.

badges.title: Assigned Seating
badges.description: Place a sprite on top of a random tile on a tilemap.
